From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Hannah Recruitment <hannah@recruitco.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: REQ-129 — final interview feedback and ask for panel decision

Team — attaching the consolidated interview evaluation for Ethan Li (final loop done yesterday). Quick summary up front:
- Candidate: Ethan Li (Sr Data Engineer) — strong ETL and Python; weaker systems-design at scale, limited experience with streaming joins and stateful windowing.
- Interview averages: 3.1/5, with two interviewers flagging architecture gaps.
- Compensation: candidate expects ~ $230–250k TCoC (base + equity + bonus). Our current band for REQ-129 caps at roughly $195k TCoC for external hire.

Attached: req129-eval-sheet.pdf (detailed interviewer notes) and comp-band-analysis.csv (band ceilings + suggested exceptions).

Please reply with your vote: (1) Extend offer with band exception (and proposed structure), (2) Make an offer within band (likely declined), or (3) Close req / No hire and re-open later with clearer scope. If you vote to proceed, include suggested comp numbers and any conditions (start date, level adjustments).

Context: this req is priority for Analytics platform but we are mindful of comp compression vs internal parity (see comp sheet). Need decision by EOD PDT Monday so recruiting can close loop.

Thanks —
Vivek

I appreciate Laura's callout and the risk analysis. Quick counterpoints for the record before we close:
1) Candidate has strong infra shipping velocity and would unblock a major analytics backlog item within Q1; that's operational value.
2) We could offer a comp structure that leans base toward the band ceiling and compresses equity (example: $195k base + $30k sign-on + 0.12% refreshable RSU instead of larger equity grant). That keeps band messaging intact while addressing candidate expectations short-term.
3) If we do close, I propose we capture the specific skill gaps (streaming joins/stateful windows) as gating items for any future re-open so recruiters can screen better.

If leadership (Laura/Vivek) still wants to close, I respect that — just want these options recorded.

-Marissa

Subject: REQ-129 — Finalization and closeout (no hire)

Thanks all for the quick takes — I’m documenting the panel decision here.

Decision: NO HIRE — close REQ-129.
Reasoning (summary):
- Interview feedback shows technical gaps in the core system-design areas required for this role (stateful streaming joins, large-scale joined-window correctness).
- Comp request materially exceeds current band and would create internal compression issues; proposed sign-on tweaks still leave parity concerns.
- Operational value argument acknowledged, but risk to product reliability and ramp time are non-trivial.

Immediate action items (owners):
- Recruiting (Marissa / Hannah): close the candidate loop and send standard withdraw/thanks to Ethan Li. If candidate is open to a staff-level path later, capture as passive. [Due: 10/05]
- Req management (Vivek): update Greenhouse status to "Closed - No Hire", attach eval sheet and a 1-paragraph closeout rationale. [Due: 10/06]
- Finance/Headcount (Soojin): flag the freed FTE for reallocation in the next headcount cadence; do not automatically convert to bench hires. [Due: 10/12]
- Hiring guidance (Marissa): add a short checklist item to screening templates for streaming/real-time joins to avoid repeats. [Due: 10/08]

Attachments saved: req129-eval-sheet.pdf, comp-band-analysis.csv (already in drive: https://drive.redwood.com/req129/closeout-notes)

Marissa/Hannah — please confirm when candidate has been notified. I’ll update exec hiring tracker after confirmation.

Thanks —
